ClientIp.__comment: Merchant API calls are checked against each merchant's IP allowlist. Behind Cloudflare the caller's address is in CF-Connecting-IP, which is believed ONLY on connections from these ranges: Cloudflare's published list (https://www.cloudflare.com/ips/), fetched 2026-09-17. Update it when Cloudflare announces a change. A connection from anywhere else is judged by its own address. An empty list trusts no proxy, so every call through Cloudflare would appear to come from Cloudflare and be refused.

DefaultFee.__comment: Platform-wide fallback fee (percentage, basis points; 1bp = 0.01%) charged to a merchant with NO explicit per-asset pricing, so an unpriced merchant is never silently free. Percentage-only — a flat component is per-asset, set per-merchant via PUT /api/v1/ops/merchants/{id}/fees. 0/0 (the default) = no platform default (unpriced merchants stay free). Account opening is always free.

Sweep.__comment_policies: DEFAULTS only. A chain's effective dials live in sweep.SweepSettings, created from this section on first use and tracking it until staff save their own from the back office (PUT /ops/sweeps/settings/{chain}); after that the stored row wins. A chain absent here is never swept.
Sweep.__comment_screening: Taint segregation. Enabled=true screens each deposit address before sweeping it: clean balances go to the Safe collection wallet, flagged ones to the Danger (quarantine) wallet — so tainted inflow is never mixed into clean treasury, which cannot be undone afterwards. Requires a Danger collection wallet per chain; without one, flagged balances stay on the deposit address rather than falling back to the Safe wallet. OnUnavailable (Hold | Safe | Danger) covers an address with no fresh verdict; Hold is the default and simply waits. MaxScreeningsPerPass bounds what one pass may spend of the provider quota the payout gate shares.

Accounting.__comment: 5c platform gas accounting: each chain's native gas coin (TRX for TRON) is booked under this ledger AssetId (DEBIT NetworkFeeExpense / CREDIT PlatformFunding, in sun). Deliberately NOT a deposit-catalog asset, so it never turns on native-coin deposit scanning. Inert in dev (in-memory engine charges no fee).

Kms.__comment: PRODUCTION custody (§10). Enable to bring withdrawal/sweep money-out + address provisioning online via AWS KMS envelope encryption: seeds are minted in-process, sealed under a per-purpose customer-managed CMK, and only the ciphertext is stored (in this DB) — the two-factor model (KMS key + DB, either alone useless). Identifiers only, NEVER secrets; the app authenticates by its instance/task IAM role. Left disabled here so a fresh/dev environment stays inert rather than half-configured; set the ARNs + Enabled in the production environment's own config.
